content: Morning, quick update between line checks. Calder Inspection Group is handling the external quality audit this quarter so let's keep paperwork tidy. Also Lena Ostvik joined as the prototype test engineer, please help her settle in.
Quick note from the test bench, the new lidar sensor model is Scoutline S-440 so we can start fitting today. Also Falkenberg will host the autumn trade show, I'll need travel numbers soon.
One more small thing before lunch, the packaging revision is tracked under document code PX-294-C, could you file that for me please?

Hi, between builds I need to visit where we keep overflow stock out in Northridge Park Estate, then prep for when the client comes to test and sign off on 17 October. Can you hold a reminder for both?
What nickname do we use for the shop CNC machine?
That was too long, just send the nickname by itself next time please
Quick favor before lunch, could you reorder spare propellers under code VP-772-RT and confirm the evening van still leaves at 18:30 on weekdays? Yesterday ran late.
Back in the shop now, the team just started up the new Thermobake 220 for curing frames and it looks great. Let me know if maintenance writes about it.
heads up, our new QA engineer is Priya Nair going forward
Could you remind me of the arm hinge bolt torque spec?
Can you message our client about our inventory system update?
Please check with me before contacting the client, thanks!
What was the Larkspur part-number prefix again?
change of plan: my purchase-order approval limit is now 4,500 euros effective today
Can you remind me what my job title is?
just letting you know our backup machine shop town is now Halden for future orders
Which conference are we attending next month?
